task.goal: Determine whether tensor restriction, degeneration, or asymptotic-rank bounds provide a one-shot circuit for the arbitrary-mask selective matrix product.
task.question: Does a concrete example refute transferring asymptotic rank or exact rank sparsity to the selective-product interface?
task.scope: L03/L04/N12 source claims plus independent exact deductions on degeneration, rank, support pruning, and direct rank-wire evaluation.

cards_or_spans: abstract: minimum multiplication count for 2x2 multiplication is seven

assumptions: D=N^(1/4), arbitrary supplied W subset [N]^2, |W|<=N^(15/8), entries have O(log N) bits for an N-only bit bound.
The 9/4 exponent is a supplied source claim and is not independently certified in this leaf.
The exact W tensor and Strassen witness calculations are over characteristic zero; the incidence lemma is over any field.
contract.interface: Return exactly (XY)_ij for each supplied (i,j) in W; no promise that W is value-dependent or that the output support can be discovered from X,Y.

charged: coefficient heights and exact integer bit operations
costs.transposition_reduction: If a division-free value-independent circuit for Z_W Y^T costs T and is acquired at cost P, reverse evaluation and gradient writes cost O(T+ND+|W|), plus P.

inherited_or_supplied: L03's conditional all-fixed-field arithmetic exponent transfer.
L04's arbitrary-mask interface and complete-block-cover obstruction, restricted to independently charged block covers.
Astra export's exact rational Strassen gauge matrices and the primary-source pins.
acquired: Reconstructed the tensor-power quantifier order and Cartesian-power output mask.
Derived the W-tensor border-rank 2 / exact-rank 3 example using a slice-pencil invariant.
Recomputed the rational dense-gauged Strassen identity and its 84 nonzero leg coefficients.
Reproved the coefficient-slice incidence lower bound and charged it only for independent rank-form evaluation.

candidate.representation: Exact tensor T_(W,D)=sum_(i,j in W,k) z_ij x_ik y_kj; full-product rank decompositions with invertible basis changes; W3 degeneration family.
candidate.hypothesis: Asymptotic rank and total rank alone do not imply a uniformly acquired, support-local, one-shot selective circuit.

missing_lemma: A uniformly acquired mask-dependent shared circuit for Z_W Y^T with preprocessing plus encoding, arithmetic, bit, and decoding costs O(N^(2-eta) polylog N) for every legal supplied W.
comparator: Full thin multiplication costs N^(2+o(1)) field operations and writes N^2 outputs; independent selected dot products cost |W|D. Complete-block covers are not a general-circuit comparator.
falsifier_or_next_experiment: Produce a concrete uniform shared factorization for every legal W and charge all gates, coefficients, preprocessing, bits, and outputs below N^(2-eta) polylog N. The local exact Strassen witness is falsified by any zero leg coefficient or failed basis-pair identity.
unresolved_or_UNKNOWN: No one-shot rank bound matching N^(1445/744) for varying arbitrary W was derived.
No bit-efficient acquisition or shared encoder for arbitrary-mask Z_W Y^T was found.
The source-derived OpenAI exponent claim and historical priority remain external review questions.
No lower bound against arbitrary arithmetic circuits is claimed.
status_note: Exact witness recomputed over rational arithmetic; source claims were not promoted to externally validated results.
